dct_title_s: Map of the Navajo Country, Arizona, New Mexico, and Utah
dct_description_sm: "Base compiled by U.S. Geological Survey for map on scale of 1:1,000,000 with additional information obtained by Herbert E. Gregory in 1908-1913."
4 legends under headings "routes of scientific exploration before 1909," "buildings," "culture," and "water features."
